welcome_panel.title: Welcome to {{app_name}}
features: Toggle POS carts between Eat In and Takeaway from a smart grid tile
Automatically add an eat-in charge to dynamic (cold food and drink) products
Tag orders and record the eat-in charge total against every order
Report and export eat-in and takeaway totals for your VAT returns
